assets.purpose: Exact 1 / 5 / 2 tomatoes with identical plate scale for amounts added to a specified two-tomato recipe.
assets.prompt: Use case photorealistic-natural. Create one horizontal 3:1 landscape photographic triptych with EXACTLY THREE EQUAL panels divided by thin plain white vertical gutters, for precise beginner English counting/recipe practice. Same light oak kitchen preparation counter, same white round ceramic shallow plate, identical overhead camera and scale, soft natural light in each panel. The plates are clean empty apart from the whole raw red tomatoes specified. LEFT PANEL: exactly ONE whole red tomato in the center of one white plate. CENTER PANEL: exactly FIVE whole red tomatoes on one white plate, in a loose pentagon, separated with visible white space between every tomato, NO overlaps or stacks, all five fully visible. RIGHT PANEL: exactly TWO whole red tomatoes side by side on one white plate, separate with visible white space between them. All tomatoes are comparable medium size, naturally irregular, one or two have tiny green calyxes but no detached leaves or extra red props. EACH PANEL is a photograph of a plate as a separate preparation option for a recipe. Exact total across image is EIGHT tomatoes, distributed 1 / 5 / 2. Full plates within their panels, no cropping of plate edges, no perspective distortion. No bowls, no cut tomatoes, no other food, no hands, no utensils, no text, NO numbers or letters or badges. Environmental countertop background retained. Rich lifelike red, warm neutral oak, sharp clean ingredient identification, no illustration. Counts and equal legible scale are essential.

assets.prompt: Create a realistic photographic cutout for an adult beginner English textbook recipe-planning task. One friendly young adult male home cook, with short dark curly hair and a simple olive green apron over a white casual T-shirt, shown from head to mid thigh, upright but relaxed three-quarter pose. He holds a medium white ceramic bowl of chopped tomato salad with small white cheese pieces in his left hand at chest height, tilted slightly toward viewer so the food is visible. His right hand holds one wooden mixing spoon above the bowl, with a natural bent elbow, as if inviting someone to plan a salad. Both hands anatomically correct and completely visible; arms not crossed; bowl, spoon and fingers fully in frame. Gentle interested expression, eyes looking toward the viewer's right where an exercise will be placed. Candid professional editorial food photography, natural skin texture, soft natural directional lighting, bright clear food colours. Isolated full figure with transparent background, native alpha. No backdrop, no square panel, no furniture, no text, no border, no logos, no floor shadow. Not a cartoon, not a celebrity. Keep clothing opaque. Clear silhouette suitable for a tall textbook inset.
